parameters.query:
WITH target AS (SELECT * FROM rendez_vous WHERE token_gestion='{{$json.token}}'::uuid AND statut IN ('CONFIRME','EN_ATTENTE') FOR UPDATE),
upd_r AS (UPDATE rendez_vous SET statut='ANNULE',motif_annulation=NULLIF(replace('{{$json.motif}}','''',''''''),''),cancelled_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM target) RETURNING *),
upd_c AS (UPDATE creneaux SET places_reservees=GREATEST(places_reservees-1,0),statut=CASE WHEN statut='COMPLET' THEN 'DISPONIBLE' ELSE statut END,updated_at=now() WHERE id IN (SELECT creneau_id FROM upd_r)),
h AS (INSERT INTO historique_rendez_vous(rendez_vous_id,action,ancien_statut,nouveau_statut,details) SELECT id,'ANNULATION',statut,'ANNULE',jsonb_build_object('motif',motif_annulation) FROM target),
n AS (INSERT INTO notifications(rendez_vous_id,type,canal,destinataire,statut) SELECT id,'ANNULATION','EMAIL',email,'A_ENVOYER' FROM upd_r WHERE email IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING)
SELECT id,reference,statut,cancelled_at FROM upd_r;
